note: OTGA’s October 2024 data policy, repeated in the published 2026 guidelines, explicitly states that participant, facilitator and expert information is archived in the IODE OceanExpert database and linked to the OTGA Moodle alumni system. Full records are accessible only to the OTGA Secretariat and IODE IT support; course-completion information and profiles have a public subset. This edge describes that documented archival/linked-data flow. It does not assert a public bulk export, automatic refresh cadence, bidirectional replication or unrestricted personal-data access.
